title: Back to Goodman and the end of his salary
summary: After a break, Benny paid him for a year and then he stopped.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Before we got into our philosophical discussion, I guess we had gotten pretty much to the point where we were talking about your period of illness and Benny was still paying you something of a salary, but finally that all came to an end.
He paid me for a year and then I went back to work again.
I think it came to about '44, that's the period when I couldn't hear anymore and I had to stop.
